unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Mum bought a modern electric cooker for our new kitchen.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 妈妈为我们的新厨房买了一个现代化的电炉。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：cook (做饭) + er (器具) -> 炊具、炉灶。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Put some cream on the cake.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 在蛋糕上抹点奶油。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: cr(超人)+eam(类似team团队)：超人团队爱吃奶油。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The fresh roast duck had delicious crispy skin.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 新鲜的烤鸭有着美味的脆皮。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：crisp (脆) + y -> 松脆的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The cute boy has natural curly black hair.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这个可爱的男孩有一头天生的黑色卷发。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：curly hair 卷发 vs straight hair 直发。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Customer
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 顾客
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：custom(风俗/习惯) + er(人)，习惯经常来店里买东西的人就是顾客。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 骑自行车 `n.` 周期；循环
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: On sunny afternoons, we often cycle along the river bank.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 在晴朗的下午，我们经常沿着河岸骑自行车。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：cycle to school 骑车去上学。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Be careful not to delete any important documents from your computer.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 小心不要从电脑中删除任何重要的文件。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：delete key 键盘上的删除键。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: No one can deny that regular exercise is good for health.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 没有人能否认经常锻炼对健康有益。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：deny doing sth. 否认做过某事。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is the world's biggest desert?
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 世界上最大的沙漠是什么？
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: de（得）+ sert（塞特）-> 在沙漠里得塞特饼干吃

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A balanced diet is essential for fitness.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 均衡的饮食对健康至关重要。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆：diet 谐音“代一天”，节食减肥，吃饭找人代替一天。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The family gathered together to dine at their favourite restaurant.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 全家人聚在一起，在他们最喜欢的餐厅用餐。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：dine out 外出就餐。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 直接的；笔直的；直爽的 `v.` 监督；指导
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: gives direct opinions
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 给出直接的意见
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：di(低)+rect(正确/直线)→低头直接走直线最省事→“直接的”

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Grandma rolled out the soft dough to make handmade dumplings.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 奶奶揉好软软的面团来包手工饺子。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：make dough 和面团。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The doctor did everything possible to save the dying animal.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 医生尽了一切努力去拯救那只垂死的动物。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 现在分词/形容词：die -> dying (垂死的)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This project will have a huge effect on girls' education.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这个项目将对女童教育产生巨大的影响。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 对比记忆：affect是动词（影响），effect是名词（效果）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Chinese families hold a big reunion dinner on Chinese New Year's Eve.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 中国家庭在除夕夜吃丰盛的团年饭。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：Christmas Eve 平安夜；New Year's Eve 除夕。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 使兴奋，使激动，引起，激发
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The news of the school trip excited all the pupils.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 学校旅行的消息让所有的学生都兴奋不已。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：excite (动词激起) -> exciting (令人兴奋的)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Aesop's Fables teaches us many wise life lessons.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 《伊索寓言》教给我们许多充满智慧的人生道理。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：Aesop's Fables《伊索寓言》。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The English exam was fairly easy, so most students finished on time.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 英语考试相当简单，所以大多数学生都按时完成了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fair (公平的) + ly -> 公平地，相当地。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 落下的；倒下的 `v.` fall 的过去分词
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The autumn path was covered with golden fallen leaves.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 秋天的林荫小路上铺满了金色的落叶。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 分词形容词：fallen leaves 落叶。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Decide whether each sentence is true or false.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 判断每个句子是真是假。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：true or false (对还是错)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please send the signed agreement to our office by fax.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 请通过传真将签署好的协议发到我们办公室。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fax machine 传真机。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 家伙，同事，同伴 `adj.` 同伴的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She encouraged her fellow classmates to study together.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她鼓励同班同学一起学习。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fellow students 同学；fellow workers 同事。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 围栏，栅栏，篱笆 `v.` 隔开
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A white wooden fence surrounds their lovely front garden.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 一道白色的木栅栏围着他们可爱的前花园。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：wooden fence 木栅栏。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 女的，女性的；母的，妇女的 `n.` 女子；雌性动物
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Sex: Female
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 性别：女
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fe（副，阴性）+ male（男性）= 女性的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 渡船，摆渡 `v.` 渡运，摆渡
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We crossed the wide harbour by passenger ferry.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们乘坐客轮穿过了宽阔的海港。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：take a ferry 乘渡轮。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The big shark cut through the water with its dorsal fin showing.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 那条大鲨鱼破水前进，背鳍露在水面上。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：shark fin 鲨鱼鳍。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 公司 `adj.` 坚定的，牢固的，稳固的，结实的 `adv.` 坚信 `v.` 使坚实，使坚固
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He is working for a big firm and he has already visited a great number of different places in Australia.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他在一家大公司工作，已经去过澳大利亚许多不同的地方。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 扶姆(firm)妈的公司是大公司。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 舰队，机群，车队 `adj.` 快速的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A large fishing fleet returned to port before the typhoon arrived.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 大批渔船在台风到来之前回到了港口。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：a fleet of ships 一支舰队。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 下列的，下述的 `n.` 下列，如下 `prep.` 在……之后
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Answer the following questions after reading the article carefully.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 请在仔细阅读文章后回答下列问题。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：the following day 次日；the following questions 下列问题。
